title: What Happens When You Load a Page

scenes.title: You click a link
scenes.narration: [[browser]]You click a link, and your browser starts looking for the page.

scenes.title: The CDN
scenes.narration: Images and scripts come from [[cdn]]a CDN, [[browser-cdn]]a server close to you.

scenes.title: The gateway
scenes.narration: Requests for data go on to [[gateway]]an API gateway, [[cdn-gateway]]the single front door.

scenes.title: What a request looks like
scenes.narration: A typical request is just text: [[req.1]]a method and path, [[req.2]]the host, [[req.3]]who is asking, [[req.4]]and what format to reply in.

scenes.title: The app server
scenes.narration: The gateway hands each request to [[app]]an application server, [[gateway-app]]which does the real work.

scenes.title: The fast path
scenes.narration: The server checks [[cache]]a cache first, [[app-cache]]because memory is very fast.

scenes.title: The slow path
scenes.narration: On a miss, it asks [[db]]the database, [[app-db]]which is slower but always right.
